The vendored tree includes the upstream picoquic source needed for a clean
build. Omni adds an FD-control Unix-socket path for executable Android use;
the original JNI path remains available for library embedders. No SlipNet
application code, native binary, or keystore is used.

Build-script helper modules are relocated from build/ to build_support/ so
source archives that exclude build directories retain them. Omni also passes
the exact vendored static OpenSSL archives to Android CMake; this avoids
out-of-sysroot lookup failures and accidental host-library selection. The
Android Cargo configuration also extends the 16-KB/separate-segment link
flags to i686 so all four packaged ABIs follow the same ELF policy.
